tokenizer.identifier: whole lowercase plus distinct underscore/camel-case parts; no same-lexeme duplicates

routing_records.name: cocosair
routing_records.description: Route Cocos AIR tasks across subsystem skills and direct dependencies. Use to choose a primary owner, adapt Creator knowledge, or apply Code First and capability-evidence rules.
when_to_use: which skill owns this AIR task
choose only the dependencies needed for this step
adapt Creator knowledge to code-first AIR
distinguish source exports from proven browser capabilities

metadata.description_zh: 为 Cocos AIR 任务选择主技能和直接依赖，并遵循原生 API、启动时序与能力证据分层。用于开始 AIR 开发、定位能力归属或选择技能。

routing_records.name: cocosair-2d-subsystems
routing_records.description: Build DragonBones, TiledMap, particles and billboards from runtime data. Use for raw asset strings, missing pixels, MotionStreak or Spine backend limits.
when_to_use: build DragonBones assets from raw JSON strings
TiledMap edits do not redraw or resolve objects
particles compute but render no pixels
Spine skeleton stays blank without an error
billboard or motion trail is invisible
not_for: basic UI layout and controls -> cocosair-ui-2d

metadata.description_zh: 配置 Spine、DragonBones、TiledMap、二维粒子和 Billboard 的原生运行时契约。用于资源构造、空白画面或子系统能力边界问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-agent-session
routing_records.description: Inspect live scenes and frames with devtools; read runtime diagnostics. Use for scoped session writes, pixel probes or duplicate requestId INVALID_ARGUMENT errors.
when_to_use: inspect the running scene or node
apply a scoped change through an agent session
capture a frame after drawing
read runtime errors and diagnostics
duplicate requestId is rejected
not_for: verification gates and release evidence -> cocosair-verification

metadata.description_zh: 使用开发工具观察运行时、按明确范围写入、捕获画面和读取诊断。用于实时应用检查或受控自动化，工具不属于默认运行时包。

routing_records.name: cocosair-animation-tween
routing_records.description: Animate with tweens, AnimationClip tracks and a single step clock. Use for looping, reverseTime, playback cleanup, deterministic frames or unavailable pose graphs.
when_to_use: move or rotate a node over time
a clip plays once instead of looping
a tween will not reverse
track classes fail to import by name
step deterministic frames without a second live clock
not_for: glTF loading and instance setup -> cocosair-gltf
skeletal binding and morph weights -> cocosair-skinning-morph

metadata.description_zh: 使用 AnimationClip、Animation 和 tween，管理播放模式、组合及单一时钟。用于动画播放、补间回收或确定性步进问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-application
routing_records.description: Configure createAirApp options, canvas, lifecycle, screen sizing and context health. Use for WEBGL2_REQUIRED startup errors, scene replacement, session cleanup or lost contexts.
when_to_use: createAirApp rejects options or fails startup
replace or release the running scene
app closed and will not restart
fit a container or set design resolution
lost context or scene cleanup stalls
not_for: package imports or page shell -> cocosair-project-setup

metadata.description_zh: 配置 createAirApp 和应用生命周期、屏幕尺寸、会话清理及 WebGL 上下文健康。用于启动错误、场景替换、关闭和自定义 canvas。

routing_records.name: cocosair-assets
routing_records.description: Load assets, textures, atlases and BMFont through AssetBank. Use for cache/refcount ownership, runtime pixels or AIR_E_ATLAS_IN_USE and AIR_E_FNT_IN_USE cleanup.
when_to_use: load remote files without a Creator resources bundle
the same URL returns a destroyed asset
create a texture from canvas or pixel data
load a sprite atlas or bitmap font
an atlas or font handle refuses to dispose
not_for: glTF or GLB model loading -> cocosair-gltf
bind an existing font to Label -> cocosair-ui-2d
live HTML textures and DOM -> cocosair-graphics-and-dom

metadata.description_zh: 管理远程资产、AssetBank 引用计数、纹理、图集和位图字体。用于加载、缓存、取消、共享资源释放或字体导入问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-audio-video
routing_records.description: Play media with AudioService, VideoPlayer and WebView. Use for silent autoplay, advancing currentTime, BGM/SFX channels or DOM video and iframe overlays.
when_to_use: audio starts silently before a user gesture
control BGM and SFX channels or volume
prove playback time actually advances
place video above or below the canvas
WebView mounts the wrong URL
not_for: DOM input geometry or HTML textures -> cocosair-graphics-and-dom

metadata.description_zh: 管理音频通道、用户手势解锁、播放证据、VideoPlayer 和 WebView。用于媒体加载、播放、平台限制或资源清理。

routing_records.name: cocosair-camera
routing_records.description: Configure Camera projection, viewports, framing and screen/world conversion. Use for split-screen, pointer rays, wrong screenToWorld results or AIR_E_ORTHO_WIDTH.
when_to_use: switch perspective and orthographic views
fit a loaded model in view
stack cameras or create split-screen views
convert pointer pixels to a world ray
screenToWorld results or orthographic width are wrong

metadata.description_zh: 配置相机投影、视口、可见层和多相机顺序，并进行坐标转换、射线拾取与模型取景。用于相机配置或屏幕与世界坐标问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-gltf
routing_records.description: Load glTF/GLB models, extensions, decoder injection and instances. Use for Draco/meshopt/KTX2 deployment, GLTF_DECODER_MISSING, uncoded load errors or animation loops.
when_to_use: load a glTF or GLB from URL or bytes
compressed model will not load
which glTF extensions are supported
instance animation will not loop
destroying a model leaves GPU resources
not_for: skeleton bind poses or morph weights -> cocosair-skinning-morph

metadata.description_zh: 加载 glTF 和 GLB，配置解码器、扩展、进度、实例和错误处理。用于模型加载、压缩资源部署和加载器能力诊断。

routing_records.name: cocosair-graphics-and-dom
routing_records.description: Draw Graphics/SVG shapes, rich fills and sprite masks; bind DOM overlays and experimental HTML textures. Use for vector export, gradients, UI blend scopes or AirUIMesh.
when_to_use: draw shapes or export curves as SVG
paint gradients, patterns or evenodd holes
mask a sprite or inherit subtree blending
keep a DOM input attached to a UI node
display live HTML or warp textured UI geometry
not_for: keyboard focus and action routing -> cocosair-input-action

metadata.description_zh: 使用 Graphics、SVG、栅格填充、纹理显示、遮罩、混合和 DOM 覆盖层。用于绘图导出、富填充或实验性 HTML 纹理。

routing_records.name: cocosair-input-action
routing_records.description: Wire keyboard, mouse, touch and action state; navigate SceneStack pages. Use for focus, held-key resets, session gates, DOM canvas errors or persistent push/pop.
when_to_use: map keys, touch or mouse to named actions
keys stop firing while an input has focus
DOM input fails without an explicit canvas
clear held actions after blur or page hiding
preserve page state across push/pop transitions
not_for: node lifecycle and custom events -> cocosair-scene-graph

metadata.description_zh: 处理原生和 DOM 输入、动作状态、焦点、会话门禁及 SceneStack。用于按键触摸、动作映射、输入阻断或清理问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-materials-effects
routing_records.description: Configure materials, effects, uniforms, defines and GLSL. Use for setProperty, missing textures, AIR_E_MATERIAL_NOT_READY, AIR_E_MATERIAL_TYPE or uniform buffer too small.
when_to_use: setProperty changes nothing
texture missing after setProperty
different colors for each renderer
change blend or depth state
custom GLSL shader fails

metadata.description_zh: 配置材质、效果、属性类型、宏和自定义 GLSL。用于 USE_TEXTURE、uniform 类型、效果初始化或材质诊断问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-math
routing_records.description: Compute vectors, matrices, quaternions, colors and easing. Use for out-first math, frozen Vec3.UP errors, transform composition, rotation units or Mat4.invert.
when_to_use: normalize or project a direction
compose or decompose a transform matrix
choose quaternion rotation and angle units
convert colors or calculate easing and deterministic random
writing a frozen vector constant throws
not_for: screen and world camera conversion -> cocosair-camera

metadata.description_zh: 使用 Cocos 数学类型进行向量、矩阵、四元数、颜色和插值计算。用于坐标变换、旋转、颜色处理、缓动或确定性随机。

routing_records.name: cocosair-performance
routing_records.description: Reduce draws with batching, instancing and dynamic atlases; profile frame budgets. Use for on-demand rendering, AIR_E_MESH_CAPACITY or AIR_E_PIXEL_RATIO_IMPORT_ORDER.
when_to_use: draw calls equal the object count
batch many static meshes or UI sprites
measure actual draw counts and frame budget
stop rendering until the next requested frame
high pixel density makes the device too slow
not_for: startup admission and app lifecycle -> cocosair-application

metadata.description_zh: 选择静态合批、动态图集和实例化，并检查性能统计、剔除和按需渲染。用于大量对象、动画或绘制性能优化。

routing_records.name: cocosair-physics
routing_records.description: Choose builtin, cannon or Box2D physics; wire rigid bodies, colliders and raycasts. Use for missing gravity, trigger filters, backend limits or material error 9642.
when_to_use: dynamic bodies do not fall or stack
triggers stop firing after changing collision groups
choose builtin or cannon before startup
query 2D bodies with raycasts or overlap tests
physics material error 9642 appears

metadata.description_zh: 选择 builtin 或 cannon，并区分碰撞检测、运动积分和二维 Box2D 的能力。用于刚体、触发器、射线查询或物理后端问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-primitives-mesh
routing_records.description: Build primitive geometry, Mesh buffers and MeshRenderer bindings. Use for vertex attributes, indices, wireframes or AIR_E_PRIMITIVE_DESCRIPTOR validation.
when_to_use: generate a box, sphere, cylinder or cone
attach procedural geometry to a renderer
author custom vertex buffers and indices
read or copy mesh attributes
a primitive descriptor fails validation
not_for: skeletal binding or morph weights -> cocosair-skinning-morph

metadata.description_zh: 构建基本几何和原生 Mesh，检查顶点属性、索引、边界与渲染器写入契约。用于代码生成几何或自定义网格。

routing_records.name: cocosair-project-setup
routing_records.description: Set up npm imports, package entries, importmap, TypeScript and variant builds. Use for cocosair.js installation, unresolved-import errors, page shells or build artifacts.
when_to_use: install or import cocosair.js
imports resolve to the wrong entry
TypeScript editor declarations fail
wire a page importmap and canvas
which build command produces this artifact
not_for: live HTML textures or overlays -> cocosair-graphics-and-dom

metadata.description_zh: 安装和配置 Cocos AIR 项目，选择包入口、importmap、TypeScript 声明和变体构建。用于安装导入、页面骨架、类型解析或构建产物问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-rendering
routing_records.description: Configure lighting, shadows, render targets, MSAA and sRGB. Use for offscreen pixels, post-processing, AIR_E_RENDER_TARGET_SAMPLES or AIR_E_TEXTURE_COLOR.
when_to_use: scene brightness looks wrong
no shadows from lights
render mirror or refraction into a texture
texture looks washed out after load
can bloom or post-processing run

metadata.description_zh: 配置灯光、阴影、渲染目标、MSAA、颜色契约和管线可达性。用于光照、阴影、离屏渲染、读回或后处理问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-scene-graph
routing_records.description: Build Scene/Node hierarchies, Component lifecycles, layers and events. Use for reparenting, active inheritance, NodePool reuse, scene globals or resource release.
when_to_use: attach or reparent nodes in a scene
understand component lifecycle and update order
a child is inactive or inherits unexpected scale
manage node events, layers or object pools
release scenes and external listeners without leaking
not_for: native input and action mapping -> cocosair-input-action

metadata.description_zh: 使用原生 Scene、Node、Component 构建场景树并管理层、事件、生命周期和资源释放。用于节点组织、组件更新、对象池或场景配置。

routing_records.name: cocosair-skinning-morph
routing_records.description: Bind skeletons, restore bind poses and drive morph weights. Use for realtime/baked deformation, AIR_E_SKINNING_JOINT_PATH or AIR_E_SKINNING_CAPACITY.
when_to_use: build or bind a skeleton from joint paths
a skinned mesh stays in its rest pose
bone edits stop working in baked mode
restore the captured bind pose
morph weight changes appear to be ignored
not_for: glTF loading and decoder deployment -> cocosair-gltf

metadata.description_zh: 配置骨骼路径、蒙皮、绑定姿态、Morph 权重和烘焙动画。用于骨骼变形、绑定姿态恢复或 Morph 问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-ui-2d
routing_records.description: Build Canvas UI with sprites, Label text, layout and widgets. Use for missing UI, viewport alignment, 2D draw order, BMFont binding or AIR_E_LABEL_WRAP.
when_to_use: put sprites, labels or controls on screen
UI renders nothing despite visible nodes
widgets must realign after a viewport change
bind an existing bitmap font to Label
2D sprites and labels overlap in the wrong order
not_for: load or parse a bitmap font -> cocosair-assets
sprite masks and DOM overlays -> cocosair-graphics-and-dom
native input and action mapping -> cocosair-input-action

metadata.description_zh: 使用 Canvas、布局、控件、Label、位图字体和二维排序。用于 UI 构建、文本显示或交互布局问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-verification
routing_records.description: Choose verification gates and assess browser/package evidence, write behavior and fingerprints. Use to validate changes, distinguish FAIL/UNSUPPORTED or check release readiness.
when_to_use: choose focused gates for a changed contract
check whether a verify command writes files
verify package imports or actual browser behavior
check report fingerprints and coverage scope
assess release readiness without trusting stale evidence

metadata.description_zh: 选择并解释 AIR 验证门禁、写行为、指纹和逐 API 证据。用于验证改动、包消费、浏览器行为或发布候选。

results.prompt: How should I choose the primary skill and only its direct dependencies for a request spanning several AIR subsystems, changing the owner as the current step changes?
For a DragonBones armature, should atlasJson and dragonBonesJson receive parsed objects or raw JSON strings, and when should I assign armatureName?
I want a devtools agent to inspect the running scene and make a controlled node change. How do session-local IDs and writableScenes govern dispatch?
How can I run two independent tweens on one target and loop a sequence of position and scale changes?
How do I register scene-owned cleanup callbacks and replace the running scene safely without reloading the page?
How do I load a bitmap font from a .fnt URL and retain its page texture until the font handle can be disposed?
How do I play BGM and SFX with separate volume controls, then verify that audio currentTime actually advances after a user gesture?
How do I switch between perspective and orthographic camera framing, choose fov or orthoHeight, and fit a loaded model in view?
How do I load a compressed glTF/GLB model, inject its Draco, meshopt or KTX2 decoders before loading, and inspect extension support?
How do I keep an editable DOM input aligned with a UI node using an overlay while the canvas moves or resizes?
How do I map held keys and pointer input to named game actions and consume pressed/released edges once per tick?
How do I initialize a builtin-standard material with metallic and roughness properties and enable its albedo texture macro before setProperty?
What are the angle units for Quat.fromEuler and Quat.fromAxisAngle, and how should I use the out-first matrix and quaternion operations?
I have 1000 identical cubes producing 1000 draw calls. How do I choose instancing or static batching and verify the actual draw count?
My objects need gravity, falling and stacking. Should I choose builtin or cannon physics, and when must I select the backend?
How do I author a custom vertex buffer and index layout, create a Mesh, and read its attributes back out?
How do I install cocosair.js in a bundler project or wire its importmap in a static HTML page, using the supported package entry?
My directional light gives the wrong brightness and no shadows. Which lighting units, shadow support rules and cast/receive switches should I inspect?
What happens when I re-parent or destroy a Node, and which external listeners must I unsubscribe rather than relying on deferred destruction?
How do I build a skeleton with full joint paths relative to its skinning root, capture bind poses, and restore the rig later?
How do I create a UI Canvas with its orthographic camera, then lay out Label and Sprite children using Widget and Layout?
Which repository gates prove browser rendering or installed-package consumption, and why do HEADLESS tests and typecheck alone not establish those claims?
The npm import cannot resolve the package entry in my bundler project; createAirApp has not run. Which export or importmap wiring should I correct?
My camera framing is correct. I need an offscreen render target for a mirror, including MSAA sample negotiation, resize bindings and pixel readback.
The lights and shadow setup are already correct, but my custom GLSL effect needs declared properties, matching setProperty value types and texture defines.
I am importing a glTF model and need to check which material extensions the loader supports and which require a decoder, rather than write a new effect.
I am loading a PNG texture by URL with an explicit extension and need refcounted AssetBank disposal. No model or glTF/GLB file is involved.
My pointer event is already delivered. How do I convert its framebuffer pixel to a world picking ray and account for the camera coordinate origin and depth conventions?
The interpolated Vec3 values are correct. I need to schedule concurrent tween motion and loop a keyed AnimationClip with the right WrapMode and clock.
The glTF model has loaded successfully. I am now debugging joint paths and bind poses while manually moving bones in realtime skinning mode.
I already have a loaded bitmap-font handle. How do I bind its font to a Label and configure text wrapping and box size in the UI?
An attached DOM overlay is misaligned and intercepts clicks over the wrong canvas area. I need to fix overlay placement; named game-action routing is not involved.
My Canvas, UI camera and layer are already visible. A DragonBones ArmatureDisplay stays static after I pass loaded objects to atlasJson and dragonBonesJson.
The instancing shader and shared material are already configured. How do I compare static merge with instancing for many identical meshes and measure saved draw calls?
createAirApp rejected with WEBGL2_REQUIRED during browser startup. How should I diagnose the unavailable WebGL 2 context and the allowed startup outcome?
A second createAirApp call rejects with AIR_E_APP_CONFLICT after I pass new contextLoss callbacks. Which normalized options and identities must match?
createAirRenderTarget throws AIR_E_RENDER_TARGET_SAMPLES for requested MSAA with sampleFallback set to error. How do I check supported and effective samples?
Texture validation rejects AIR_E_TEXTURE_COLOR when a normal map uses shader-srgb decode. Which linear-data, GPU format and decode pairing should I check?
Loading a compressed glTF model fails with GLTF_DECODER_MISSING before any instance renders. How do I diagnose absent Draco, meshopt or KTX2 decoder injection?
Material.setProperty throws AIR_E_MATERIAL_TYPE while I assign a uniform value. How do I identify the declared property shape and pass the matching engine value type?
Material.setProperty(name, value, passIdx) throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'getHandle'). I passed an out-of-range pass index; how should I diagnose the material call?
results.exact_error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'getHandle')

results.prompt: Disposing my bitmap-font handle throws AIR_E_FNT_IN_USE while Labels still reference the font. What must I detach or release before disposing its page texture?
A devtools session.dispatch node mutation returns OUT_OF_SCOPE although inspectNode can read that node. How should writableScenes constrain writes?
Binding a weighted skeleton throws AIR_E_SKINNING_JOINT_PATH for a joint path that no longer resolves below skinningRoot. How do I validate the relative joint path?
